items.detail: City of Portsmouth, NH Announces Veterans Day Observances Portsmouth, N.H. – On Wednesday, November 11, 2026 at 11 am, Veterans Day will be commemorated in Portsmouth with a wreath-laying ceremony at the Soldiers & Sailors Monument in Goodwin Park. A post-event gathering with a light meal will take place at the American Legion Post, located at 96 Islington Street. In case of rain, the event will move indoors to the Legion.
